xamlx.purpose: Existing pinned internal compiler donor used through Avalonia.Markup.Xaml.Loader IncludeXamlIlSre.props, not application authoring. Cold builds require its source even when prior donor outputs hid missing inputs.

avalonia-dbus.purpose: Existing pinned internal D-Bus bindings/source generators for Avalonia desktop accessibility. Nonempty copied Compile-glob sources are required for a cold native build.
